reason: A DSH Web UI plugin for visualizing and analyzing LLM token usage by provider, model, and date, with local persistence, cost estimation, filtering, and export features.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中提供按 API、模型和日期统计 LLM Token 用量、缓存命中率及估算成本的可视化面板。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web UI dashboard for visualizing LLM token usage, cache hit rates, and estimated costs by provider, model, and date.

capabilities: Captures per-request LLM token usage from llm/stream events
Persists usage records to a local JSONL file
Provides local aggregation and heatmap API endpoints
Displays charts, filters, summaries, and recent requests in a Web UI panel
Exports usage data as JSON and CSV
Fetches model pricing data from modelradar.cn and stores pricing locally
